name: Current / Best Percent
description: Shows current% / best% in the in-game percentage label.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Replace the in-game percentage with <cy>current% / best%</c> (shown even if the game's Show Percentage option is off). Turn off to get the vanilla percentage back.

decimals.name: Decimal Places
decimals.description: How many decimals the <cy>current</c> percentage shows, e.g. 3 gives <cy>7.412%</c>. The best stays a whole number because that's all the game saves.
